title: Day on the Beach
description: Shared Adventures' annual free adaptive ocean sports day at Cowell Beach, with kayaking, surfing and more for over 300 participants.

title: Camp Adventures
description: A four-day accessible overnight family camp (Aug 2-5) for children with disabilities ages 5-25, with climbing, archery, kayaking and more.

title: Tip-A-Cop
description: A Special Olympics NorCal fundraiser at Lazy Dog in Concord, where law enforcement serve as celebrity waitstaff with their tips donated.

title: Bike the Bridges | Bands & Brews
description: Special Olympics NorCal's annual ride at Waterfront Park in Martinez, with four scenic route options over the Martinez and Carquinez bridges.

title: Capitola Surf Camp for Youth
description: A free adaptive surf camp for youth with disabilities, hosted by Waves of Impact volunteers at Capitola.
